title: Sound Design — Selected Works
subtitle: Music, Interaction and Immersive Sound
subtitleZh: 音乐、交互与沉浸式声音
summary: Seven projects spanning original music, interactive sound systems, immersive environments and illustrated storytelling.
summaryZh: 七个项目汇集原创音乐、交互声音系统、沉浸式环境与插画叙事。
body: Seven projects, one sound practice: composing original scores, mapping gesture and voice into sound, and using music to carry atmosphere, memory and narrative across games, installations and illustrated worlds.
bodyZh: 七个项目，共同构成一套以声音为核心的实践：创作原创配乐，将手势与声音映射为实时反馈，并通过音乐在游戏、装置与插画世界中承载氛围、记忆与叙事。

items.title: External Blood Vessel
items.subtitle:
A Wearable Wireless MIDI
Instrument
items.subtitleZh: 可穿戴无线 MIDI 乐器
items.description: A wireless MIDI glove turns distance, touch, rotation and motion into notes, chords, percussion and live mix parameters. Sound is generated through the performer’s body rather than added after the interaction.
items.descriptionZh: 这只无线 MIDI 手套将距离、触摸、旋转与动作映射为音符、和弦、打击乐和实时混音参数，让声音直接由表演者的身体动作生成，而不是在交互之后附加。

video.title: Performance Demo — Running Up That Hill
video.titleZh: 演出示范 — Running Up That Hill

items.title: Water Babies
items.subtitle: Voice, Presence and Fluid Intelligence
items.description: A sensing and translation system maps audience presence and voice into a real-time field of fluid imagery, light and sound, turning frequency and movement into a non-verbal dialogue.
items.descriptionZh: 系统感知观众的在场与声音，并将其映射为实时流体影像、光线与声场，让频率和动作形成一场非语言的对话。

items.title: Still Waters Run Deep
items.subtitle: Sound for an Immersive VR Experience
items.subtitleZh: 沉浸式 VR 体验的声音设计
items.description: A dual-frequency soundscape centred on 30 Hz and 432 Hz synchronises with an underwater VR environment. Resonance, texture and spatial movement guide attention toward a slower, meditative state.
items.descriptionZh: 以 30 Hz 与 432 Hz 为核心的双频声场与水下 VR 环境同步，通过共振、质感与空间运动，引导注意力进入更缓慢、冥想式的状态。

items.title: Bridget
items.subtitle: Music for an Illustrated Story
items.description:
Fifty years after her death, Bridget is brought back through an experiment that promises a life without illness or trauma. Her memories of domestic abuse have been erased, yet a ghost-like remnant of herself survives in reflections. Water, dreams and a shattered plate gradually return what the experiment tried to remove.

The story asks whether a person can be made whole by deleting painful memories. Its blue and red illustrated scenes were brought together as a textile, carrying a fragmented inner world into a physical object. The original track “Bridget” accompanies the story.
items.descriptionZh:
去世五十年后，Bridget 在一项承诺消除疾病与创伤的实验中重获生命。遭受家庭暴力的记忆被抹去，但另一个幽灵般的自我仍存在于倒影之中。水、梦境与一只破碎的瓷盘，让被删除的过去逐渐返回。

故事追问：删除痛苦的记忆，是否就能让一个人重新完整？蓝色与红色的插画场景被组合成纺织品，让碎片化的内心世界成为可触摸的实物。原创音乐《Bridget》伴随这段叙事。

items.title: UTOPIA 2419
items.subtitle: An Original Score for Interactive Fiction
items.description: Ten original compositions trace memory, revolt, exile and the silence that follows an impossible ideal, giving a branching dystopian narrative its emotional continuity.
items.descriptionZh: 十首原创作品贯穿记忆、反抗、流亡，以及理想破灭后的寂静，为分支式反乌托邦叙事建立连贯的情绪线索。
